type: Photo-calibrated 3D reconstruction adapted from existing reference-viewer construction

sources.role: Existing procedural 3D construction, nominal22x32outline, estimatedthickness/heights; model block extracted verbatim into source/extracted-matek-original.js.
Official board dimensions and component identification; source-link audit found no downloadable3Dmodel links.
Original untouched photograph. Rectified UV calibration supplies PCB and raised-component top-face appearance, visible part locations and sizes.

limitations: No F405-WMO manufacturer STEP/STL/OBJ/GLB download was found on the product page or targeted search; this does not establish that none exists elsewhere.
Geometry is a visual reconstruction, not manufacturing geometry. Component heights, PCB thickness, pin dimensions and standoff geometry are estimated from the reference viewer and photographs.
Photo-derived positions and nominal outlines are suitable for visual comparison, not fit/tolerance checking. Perspective in elevated parts is retained in their textures.
Lower backside electronics are not invented. Upper underside SD/OSD/IMU bodies follow the available opposite-face photograph, with approximate heights.
The original reference has simple box components and an assumed stack gap; refinements preserve22x32PCB dimensions but improve visible component positions against the original photo.
Header pins are optional and default absent to match the manufacturer photograph. The board is shipped with loose headers.
